title: Roll Call
blurb: Marcus is sent up a mountain for work experience, with a pigeon he was told not to bring. A storm has wiped the station board, and nothing runs until the new Safety Inspector has checked every trainee.
note: Captions stay on. This film teaches nothing on purpose: it ends by handing the class the four-question opening check (signed change, slope with uneven steps, a function with a repeated output, a two-step equation). Students do it alone and in silence, as the inspector asks.
